# Philadelphia 76ers Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-10-13, 29:28. https://youtu.be/KqTKVExQGLo

## Summary

Josh Lloyd previews the 2026-27 Philadelphia 76ers for fantasy. His main theme is usage overlap: Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, Jaylen Brown and LeBron James all need the ball, so most of them should see their numbers drop. He calls Maxey a fade at his ADP of 8 to 10 because his steals, blocks and free throw volume last season look like best-case outcomes. Jaylen Brown is his favorite target, especially if he slides into the 40s or 50s. He will not take Embiid inside the top 50 because of repeated knee surgeries. He would take LeBron around pick 50. He says VJ Edgecombe is only worth it in the 90s. The bench is thin and uninspiring, with Adem Bona the most likely stash. Bona, Dominick Barlow and Tacko Fall are injured, and Ariel Hukporti is out for the season.

- [15:37](https://youtu.be/KqTKVExQGLo?t=937) Avoid stacking several high injury risk players on one roster unless you are deliberately going all in.

  > "You're banking on the idea of lower usage means better defensive stats. Which doesn't always happen."
- [21:49](https://youtu.be/KqTKVExQGLo?t=1309) Players with few peripheral stats need heavy minutes and usage to have fantasy value.
